entities.name: François Bédarida
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: François Bédarida, was a French academic historian. His work centred on Victorian England and France during World War II. He made significant research contributions to the study of The Holocaust. He was a director of the Maison française in Oxford among other leadership roles.
